cold_protocol.concurrency_stage: bench_concurrency.py: the same eviction of layers/<layer>, then a fresh gunicorn server (3 sync workers) per repeat; resident_after_evict recorded per repeat
cold_protocol.definition: node-cold: compute-node page cache evicted for the request's files + a fresh annzarro server process; the file server's cache is NOT controlled (not feasible to guarantee)
cold_protocol.eviction: posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) on every chunk and metadata file under the case's evict arrays (benchlib.array_files), immediately before each cold repeat; an error on any file aborts the run
cold_protocol.filer_state: uncontrolled; each dataset is read once from the filer before its first measured pass (warmread.py) and filer read speed is sampled pre / post_warm / post_measure (warmcheck.py)
cold_protocol.not_evicted: kernel dentry/inode caches and the NFS client attribute cache (no root); the file server cache
cold_protocol.server: a new annzarro start process per cold repeat (bench_http Server); warm rows reuse it
cold_protocol.verification: mincore() resident fraction of the same files before and after the eviction, per repeat (CSV columns resident_before, resident_after_evict)
